# RESH AI

> Production-grade autonomous AI voice agents, intelligent lead triage, CRM synchronization, and full-stack workflow automation for modern enterprises.

RESH AI is an enterprise AI implementation partner that designs, builds, and deploys deterministic, production-ready AI systems tailored to real business workflows. Unlike brittle wrappers or generic chatbots, RESH AI engineers custom multi-agent meshes, sub-800ms conversational voice telephonics, and automated CRM pipelines that directly eliminate operational bottlenecks and deliver verifiable ROI.

## Core Services & Solutions

1. **Autonomous AI Voice Agents**
   - Natural spoken conversations handling inbound and outbound calls.
   - Real-time interruption handling and sub-800ms end-to-end latency.
   - Live calendar dispatch (Google Calendar, Cal.com) and instant SMS/WhatsApp confirmation workflows.
   - Graceful human-in-the-loop escalation with full conversational context.

2. **AI Sales & Lead Pipeline Automation**
   - Instant lead capture, contextual enrichment, and algorithmic intent scoring.
   - Multi-channel automated follow-up sequences across Email, SMS, and WhatsApp.
   - Bi-directional CRM synchronization with deduplication and error handling.

3. **AI Customer Support Agents**
   - RAG-powered retrieval across enterprise documentation, PDFs, and ticket histories.
   - 24/7 autonomous Tier-1 issue resolution.
   - Sentiment detection and automated ticket routing.

4. **Full-Stack Business Workflow Automation**
   - End-to-end operational automation across ERPs, finance software, and internal databases.
   - Automated invoicing, document processing, and compliance reporting.
   - Event-driven webhook architecture with 99.9% uptime SLA.

5. **Custom Enterprise Multi-Agent Mesh**
   - Multi-agent orchestration of specialized autonomous agents with custom toolchains.
   - Isolated single-tenant compute options (AWS / Azure VPC).
   - Dedicated AI systems engineering support and continuous telemetry audits.

## Frequently Asked Questions (AEO Direct Answers)

- **What does RESH AI do?**
  RESH AI engineers and deploys autonomous voice agents, automated lead qualification pipelines, and custom enterprise AI workflows that eliminate repetitive tasks and increase business throughput.

- **How do RESH AI voice agents handle unexpected questions?**
  They operate with deterministic guardrails and domain-specific knowledge models. When out-of-scope or sensitive inquiries occur, the system smoothly routes the call to a human specialist with full context.

- **Does RESH AI require replacing existing software?**
  No. RESH AI integrates directly with existing CRMs (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho), communication tools, calendars, and databases via secure APIs and webhooks.

- **How long does implementation take?**
  Targeted workflows and voice agent deployments go live in 2 to 4 weeks, with initial production sandbox handovers in as little as 14 days.

- **Is client data kept private?**
  Yes. RESH AI provides a strict Zero-Training Enterprise Privacy Guarantee. Proprietary data and client calls are never used to train public LLMs.
